title: 先备份，确认手机和电脑
enTitle: Back up and check the requirements
text: 先在手机“设置 → 关于”核对准确硬件型号与系统版本。当前验收范围是 Q10 SQN100-3、Q20 SQC100-2、Passport SQW100-4，OS 10.3.3.3216。只连接一台手机，保持电量充足。
action: 从官网获取适合电脑的完整安装包并核对 SHA-256。Windows 10/11 x64；Mac 首次 Root 准备另需 macOS 14+。首次 Root 会清空手机，先备份照片、联系人和文件，电脑至少留出 15 GB。
expected: 打开应用后看到“连接手机”和“三网自动适配”入口。已有有效 Root 的手机可以跳过首次刷写。
stuck: 旧系统先走“系统升级”，约需 24 GB 空间；不要跨机型刷固件。Windows 未识别手机时再检查数据线和驱动。
enText: Check the exact hardware variant and OS in Settings → About. The validated scope is SQN100-3, SQC100-2 and SQW100-4 on OS 10.3.3.3216. Connect one charged phone.
enAction: Download the correct desktop package and verify SHA-256. Windows needs 10/11 x64; first Root preparation on Mac needs macOS 14+. Back up the phone before any wipe and allow at least 15 GB on the computer.
enExpected: The app shows Connect phone and Automatic carrier selection. A phone with working Root can skip first flashing.
enStuck: An older OS needs the System upgrade route and about 24 GB. Never use firmware for a different model. Check the USB cable and drivers if Windows does not detect the phone.
narration: 这份教程带你从首次打开工具，一直到通话验收。先备份手机，在设置、关于里面核对准确型号和系统版本。只连接一台手机，保持电量充足。已有有效 Root 的手机，可以跳过首次刷写。

title: 连接手机，按已有材料选路
enTitle: Connect the phone and choose your route
text: 用可传输数据的 USB 线连接并解锁手机，点击“连接手机”。首次开发连接按手机提示开启开发模式；已有可用 Root SSH 时无需一直开启。
action: 有旧刷机文件夹：选择整个文件夹。没有旧文件但手机已有有效 Root：选择“没有旧文件，从手机重新授权”。从未 Root 或不确定：选择对应入口，先核实状态。
expected: 检查完成后应显示手机型号、USB 网络与 Root 是否已验证。连接失败本身不能证明手机没有 Root。
stuck: 提示授权失败时找回原材料或重新授权；提示连接服务未启动时，已有 AutoRoot 的手机可打开一次 BlackBerry World 等待。不要因连接失败就直接重刷。
enText: Connect and unlock the phone using a data-capable USB cable, then select Connect phone. Enable development mode when the first development connection requires it.
enAction: Choose the whole old flashing folder if you have it. If Root works but files are missing, choose Authorize again from the phone. Use the first Root route only after checking the phone status.
enExpected: The app identifies the model, USB network and verified Root status. A failed connection does not prove that Root is absent.
enStuck: Recover the original material or authorize again for an authentication failure. With existing AutoRoot, open BlackBerry World once if the connection service has not started.
narration: 连接并解锁手机后，点击连接手机。有旧刷机文件夹，就选择整个文件夹。没有旧文件，但手机已经有有效 Root，可以从手机重新授权。连接失败，不等于手机没有 Root，不要直接重新刷机。

title: 首次 Root：获取并导入对应固件
enTitle: First Root: obtain the matching firmware
text: 进入“首次使用与连接帮助 → 首次 Root”，确认检测到的准确型号。以下用 Q20 SQC100-2 演示，其他型号必须选择自己的固件。
action: 可以点击“下载对应机型固件”，也可以通过极空间或百度网盘下载。保留完整原文件，不运行、不解压；用“选择文件…”选中，再点“校验并导入固件”。
expected: 提示固件已导入并通过校验。这只完成了原版固件导入，还没有生成个人 Root 镜像。
stuck: 下载中断可使用备用来源；导入不通过时核对机型、文件是否完整。不要改文件名或跳过校验。
enText: Open First use and connection help → First Root and check the detected model. The example uses SQC100-2; other models must use their own firmware.
enAction: Use Download matching firmware or the browser download links. Keep the complete original file without running or extracting it, select it, then choose Verify and import firmware.
enExpected: The app confirms that stock firmware was imported and verified. Personal Root images have not yet been prepared.
enStuck: Try the alternate source after a download interruption. For an import failure, check the exact model and complete file. Never bypass verification.
narration: 首次 Root 时，进入首次 Root 页面，核对准确型号。可以让应用下载，也可以通过页面里的网盘入口下载完整固件。保留原文件，不要运行或解压。选择文件后，点击校验并导入固件。

title: 继续准备个人镜像，再确认刷写
enTitle: Prepare personal images, then confirm flashing
text: 固件导入成功后，向下滚动，点击“自动准备 Root 镜像”。程序还要补齐工具、生成个人连接材料，并构建、校验镜像。
action: 看到“Root 镜像已准备”后，再核对机型和备份，勾选“已备份并核对机型，同意清空手机数据”，点击“开始刷写 Root（清空数据）”，阅读第二次确认。保持 USB 稳定，按窗口提示配合。
expected: 只有镜像准备成功、当前设备型号匹配且完成清空确认后，刷写按钮才会可用。不要把“固件已导入”当成“可以刷写”。
stuck: 按钮不可点时，先看它上方的原因。构建失败可导出反馈包；需要中断排查时保留镜像和准备记录，不要反复删除重建。
enText: After firmware import, scroll down and choose Prepare Root images automatically. The app still needs tools, personal connection material, image construction and verification.
enAction: Only after the images are ready, verify the model and backup, acknowledge the data wipe, select Start Root flashing, and read the second confirmation. Keep USB stable and follow the window prompts.
enExpected: Flashing becomes available only when image preparation, model matching and the wipe acknowledgement are complete.
enStuck: Read the reason above a disabled button. Export feedback after a build failure and retain the prepared materials for investigation.
narration: 导入成功后，还要向下滚动，点击自动准备 Root 镜像。等程序明确提示镜像已准备，再核对机型和备份，勾选同意清空手机数据。刷写会再次要求确认。请保持 USB 稳定，按提示完成，不要把导入成功当成刷写完成。

title: 完成手机设置，重新验证 Root
enTitle: Finish phone setup and verify Root again
text: 刷写结束后，在手机上完成首次设置，按该 Root 方案打开一次 BlackBerry World，再回电脑的“连接检查”。商店显示无网络不等于 Root 失败。
action: 点击“重新检测”，等待 USB、SSH 和 Root 检查完成。显示“Root 连接已验证”后继续检查 VoLTE。
expected: 准确型号、目标系统和有效 Root 均已确认。已有 Root 用户恢复连接后也从这里继续。
stuck: 刚重启的手机要先解锁并等待服务启动。身份记录不匹配时核对这台手机的可信连接材料，不要忽略校验。
enText: After flashing, complete setup on the phone and open BlackBerry World once as required by the Root method. Return to Connection check. A store network error does not itself mean Root failed.
enAction: Select Detect again. Continue only when USB, SSH and effective Root verification have completed.
enExpected: The exact model, target OS and effective Root are verified. Returning Root users join the same flow here.
enStuck: Unlock a newly rebooted phone and wait for its services. For an identity mismatch, check trusted materials for this phone instead of bypassing verification.
narration: 刷写结束后，先在手机上完成首次设置，并按 Root 方案打开一次 BlackBerry World。回到连接检查，点击重新检测。看到 Root 连接已验证，再继续。手机刚重启时，要先解锁并等服务启动。

title: 检查设备，备份并安装三网适配
enTitle: Check, back up and install carrier adaptation
text: 从主窗口进入“三网自动适配”，点击“检查设备”。核对当前手机、SIM 和运营商；使用已开通 VoLTE 的有效 USIM，并确保 LTE 数据正常。
action: 检查允许安装后，点击“备份并安装自动适配”。等待原始配置备份、下载校验、安装和回读完成，保留电脑备份。
expected: 出现“原始配置已备份，自动适配已安装”的提示及下一步重启说明。若提示需先启用，就先点“启用自动适配”。
stuck: 安装中断或状态未知时先重新检查设备，不要直接重复覆盖安装。已有旧版本时按应用给出的停用、恢复、重启顺序更新。
enText: Open Automatic carrier selection and select Check device. Verify the phone, SIM and carrier. Use an active VoLTE-enabled USIM with working LTE data.
enAction: When checks allow installation, select Back up and install automatic adaptation. Wait for backup verification, installation and read-back, and retain the computer backup.
enExpected: The app confirms the backup and installation and explains the reboot. If it asks you to enable adaptation first, do so.
enStuck: After interruption or an unknown state, check the device before retrying installation. Follow the explicit stop, restore and reboot sequence for an older payload.
narration: 打开三网自动适配，先检查设备，核对当前手机和运营商。检查通过后，点击备份并安装自动适配。等待原始配置备份、安装和回读完成，并保留电脑上的备份。如果状态未知，先重新检查设备，不要连续重复安装。

title: 用手机菜单正常重启，再检查本次开机
enTitle: Reboot normally and check the current boot
text: 在手机电源菜单选择正常重启。开机后解锁，等待约 3–5 分钟，保持 USB 连接。
action: 点击“已重启，重新检查”。如果 USB 连接尚未恢复，先点击“重新检查连接”，再读取当前状态。
expected: 应用确认本次开机的 SIM 选择、IMS 注册和 LTE。Passport 切入或离开电信入网策略时可能还需一次正常重启，按程序说明处理。
stuck: 4G 图标不能代替注册检查，飞行模式不能代替正常重启。仍在等待时先看当前阶段说明，不要重新刷机或重复安装。
enText: Use the normal reboot option in the phone power menu. Unlock it after startup and wait about 3–5 minutes with USB connected.
enAction: Select I have rebooted, check again. Recheck the connection first if USB has not recovered.
enExpected: The app verifies this boot’s SIM selection, IMS registration and LTE. Passport may need another normal reboot when entering or leaving the Telecom attachment policy.
enStuck: A 4G icon is not registration verification. Airplane mode is not a normal reboot. Follow the current stage guidance rather than reflashing or reinstalling.
narration: 安装后，用手机电源菜单正常重启。开机解锁，等待大约三到五分钟，再点击已重启、重新检查。Passport 切入或离开电信策略时，可能还要再重启一次，请按提示操作。四 G 图标不能代替本次开机的注册检查。

title: 拔掉 USB，验收真实双向通话
enTitle: Disconnect USB and test real calls
text: 看到“本次开机注册成功”后，仍要在手机上验收真实通话。注册成功与通话成功是两项检查。
action: 拔掉 USB，用系统拨号器呼出，再让另一台手机回拨。每通从接通开始计时，屏幕达到 00:35 后再手动挂断。检查双方声音、全程 LTE、号码与运营商显示。
expected: 呼入、呼出都正常，双方都听得见，通话保持 LTE。以后换卡先正常关机，换卡后再开机并等待。
stuck: 搜索网络、仅限紧急通话或首次拨号失败时保留现场，记录发生在哪一步并导出反馈。不要反复重拨、重装或重启。
enText: After current-boot registration succeeds, verify real calls on the phone. Registration and successful calls are separate checks.
enAction: Disconnect USB. Make an outgoing native-dialer call, then have another phone call back. Wait until the connected-call timer reaches 00:35 before hanging up. Check audio both ways, LTE and number/carrier display.
enExpected: Incoming and outgoing calls work with two-way audio and LTE. For later SIM changes, shut down normally first.
enStuck: Preserve the state after network search, emergency-only service or a failed first call. Record the step and export feedback rather than repeatedly calling, installing or rebooting.
narration: 本次开机注册成功后，拔掉 USB，用系统拨号器呼出，再让另一台手机回拨。每通都从接通后开始计时，到三十五秒再挂断。确认双方听得见、全程保持 LTE，号码和运营商显示正确，才算完成这次通话验收。

title: 卡住时，保存一个能排查的反馈包
text: 在当前页面点击“遇到问题 / 反馈”，写一句你做到哪一步、原本期待什么。入口在操作进行中也可使用。
action: 点击“刷新预览”检查内容，再点“保存反馈包…”。打开 ZIP 核对后，将整个文件通过原联系渠道发给开发者，或发至 octoooo@octoooo.com；应用不会自动发送。
expected: ZIP 包含当前步骤、版本、最近操作时间线、失败代码、允许的检查结果，以及可用的脱敏构建失败摘要。前一次失败不会因为重试成功而立即消失。
stuck: 只覆盖启用该功能后的最近 5 次启动，每次最多 400 条。不会自动补回旧版日志，也不打包 private 目录、密钥、手机备份或原始 SIP 日志。不要在补充说明里填写密码或号码。
enText: Select Need help / Feedback on the current page. Add a short description of the step and expected result. The entry remains available during an operation.
enAction: Refresh and review the preview, then save the ZIP. Check its contents and send the whole file through your usual contact channel or to octoooo@octoooo.com. The app sends nothing automatically.
enExpected: The ZIP includes the step, version, recent timeline, failure codes, permitted check results and available redacted build-failure excerpts. A successful retry does not immediately erase the earlier failure.
enStuck: History covers the last 5 sessions with this feature, up to 400 entries each. It cannot recover earlier-version logs and excludes private directories, keys, phone backups and raw SIP logs.
narration: 任何一步卡住，都可以点遇到问题、反馈。补充你做到了哪里，刷新预览，确认没有个人信息，再保存反馈包。把整个 ZIP 通过原联系渠道发给开发者。程序不会自动上传，之前失败的记录也不会因为一次重试成功就立即消失。
